env.title: Setup required
env.missing: Create a .env file in the project root with your Supabase credentials.
env.placeholder: Replace the example values in .env with your real Supabase project keys.
env.secretInClient: The sb_secret_ key must not go in the frontend .env. Use sb_publishable_ in VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY and put the secret only in Edge Function secrets.
env.step2: In Supabase → Settings → API, copy Project URL and anon public key
env.step3: Paste into VITE_SUPABASE_URL and VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY, then restart npm run dev
env.restart: After saving .env, stop the server (Ctrl+C) and run npm run dev again.
env.localSupabase: Your .env points to local Supabase (127.0.0.1:54321) but it is not running. Use your cloud project URL (supabase.com → Settings → API) or run npx supabase start.
env.invalidKey: The anon key in .env is invalid or a test key. Copy the anon public key from Supabase → Settings → API.
